text: On Saturday morning. <break time="0.8s" /> I reminded my uncle. <break time="0.8s" /> That I wished to go to the bazaar. <break time="0.8s" /> In the evening and he answered curtly. <break time="0.8s" /> Yes, boy, I know. <break time="0.8s" /> At seven oclock. <break time="0.8s" /> The servant came to tell me. <break time="0.8s" /> That my uncle had not yet come home. <break time="0.8s" /> And I sat staring at the clock. <break time="0.8s" /> For some time. <break time="0.8s" /> When its ticking began. <break time="0.8s" /> To irritate me. <break time="0.8s" /> I left the room. <break time="0.8s" /> And walked up and down. <break time="0.8s" /> The cold, empty, gloomy rooms upstairs. <break time="0.8s" /> Singing to myself. <break time="0.8s" /> At nine oclock. <break time="0.8s" /> I heard my uncles latchkey. <break time="0.8s" /> In the hall door. <break time="0.8s" /> And I could tell. <break time="0.8s" /> From the way he talked to himself. <break time="0.8s" /> That he had been drinking. <break time="0.8s" /> When I asked him a second time. <break time="0.8s" /> For the money to go to the bazaar. <break time="0.8s" /> He said. <break time="0.8s" /> That he had forgotten all about it. <break time="0.8s" /> Finally he gave me a florin. <break time="0.8s" /> And I held it tightly in my hand. <break time="0.8s" /> As I walked quickly. <break time="0.8s" /> Down to the station. <break time="0.8s" /> I took my seat. <break time="0.8s" /> In a third class carriage. <break time="0.8s" /> Of a deserted train. <break time="0.8s" /> Which, after an intolerable delay. <break time="0.8s" /> Crept slowly out of the station. <break time="0.8s" /> It was ten minutes to ten. <break time="0.8s" /> When I finally reached the bazaar. <break time="0.8s" /> And I saw the large building. <break time="0.8s" /> With its magical name. <break time="0.8s" /> Shining above the door.
